newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee steady at 35.81/82, RBI buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee steady at 35.81/82, RBI buys dollars.

text.p: The Indian rupee was steady at 35.812/817 on Wednesday afternoon after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bought spot dollars, dealers said.
Several banks sold dollars to RBI after the rupee touched 35.805/815 level during the day, dealers said.
The RBI was not an active buyer, they said.
RBI also bought July dollars in the forward segment, pushing up the forward premiums by one paise, dealers said.
An expected month-end spurt in dollar demand was not visible yet, some dealers said.
